exitControl.leaveDialogDescription: Are you sure you want to leave the meeting?
exitControl.leaveDialogHostNote: You are the active host. The meeting will continue without an active host unless you end it for everyone.
exitControl.endDialogDescription: This will end the meeting for everyone, kick all participants out, and finalize the artifacts and billing. This action cannot be undone.
exitControl.notRecordingTitle: Subtitles and translation work normally. Nothing from this meeting is saved, so there will be no transcript, summary or minutes afterwards.

inviteDialog.title: Invite to this meeting
inviteDialog.description: They get an email and an in-app notification with a link straight into this room.

transcriptPause.title: Pause the transcript?
transcriptPause.description: Nothing said from now on is written to the transcript or stored — translation, dubbing and voice clone keep running.

transcriptPanel.empty: Start WarpTalk to see live translation here.

controlBar.voiceOffHint: Off — you read translations instead of hearing them.
controlBar.voiceOnHint: You hear translations in your language.
controlBar.roomSpeedFastHint: Translate while people are still speaking. Faster, but still experimental.
controlBar.micNoiseOffHint: No extra filtering. Best for a headset already close to your mouth.
controlBar.micNoiseCloseHint: A headset, or a phone held to your face.
controlBar.micNoiseRoomHint: A laptop or a mic across the desk. Use this if your transcript gets worse when you sit back.
